LanguageData.EEG_RoyaltyTitle_Desc: Replaces royal title furniture requirements with Medieval Overhaul items. When ACTIVE: comprehensive medieval integration for all titles. When INACTIVE: medieval items added as supplementary options to vanilla requirements.
LanguageData.EEG_RoyaltyTrader_Desc: When ACTIVE: Replace Empire trader stocks with Medieval Overhaul goods (no orbital trader; guarded caravan). When INACTIVE: Add Medieval goods to vanilla Empire traders.
